intent: Define the complete path from First Light to Full Sovereignty. This capsule is the mountain. FORGE-os reads this, understands it, dreams on it, and may extend it.
input: Roadmap capsule loaded. FORGE-os is reading its own future.

meta.author: James Gilbert / Giblets Creations / Forge Theory Labs

phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: interpreter.c boots. capsule loads. primitive dispatches. audit written. metal acknowledged.

phases.name: The Shell
phases.goal: operator types primitives live. FORGE-os responds. every command is a capsule. history is a chain.

phases.name: Native Primitives
phases.goal: zero system() calls. zero curl. zero ls. pure C all the way down.

phases.name: Edge Nodes
phases.goal: ESP32-C6 registers as EUCLID-class citizen. emits events. master dispatches. the network is alive.

phases.name: Dream Recorder
phases.goal: dreams run nightly. scored. strong dreams promoted to capsules/. system dreams its own next steps.

phases.name: The Bootloader
phases.goal: FORGE-os builds to a flashable .iso. boots from nothing. no OS underneath. just the bootloader and the interpreter.

phases.name: Bare Metal Ryzen
phases.goal: Ryzen boots FORGE-os. nothing else. ESP32-C6 registers on boot. dream recorder fires at 02:00. full sovereignty.

phases.name: Sovereignty Lock
phases.goal: every capsule signed. hash chain verified. MSL embedded in bootloader. FORGE-os v1.0 tagged. nobody runs this without the author's name on it.

phases.name: Autonomous Networking
phases.goal: UDP broadcast node discovery. Edge nodes securely request primitives. FORGE-os master orchestrates a swarm over the local network.

phases.name: Distributed Data Cube
phases.goal: Data Cube shards across the swarm. Master uses native UEFI file I/O storage.

phases.name: Capsule Marketplace
phases.goal: Nodes can request and receive capsules from peer nodes.

phases.name: Elections & Leader
phases.goal: Swarm elects a leader node when master is offline.

phases.name: Edge Node Sleep Cycles
phases.goal: Battery-powered edge nodes sleep and sync with master.

phases.name: Over-the-Air Updates
phases.goal: Master can push kernel updates to edge nodes.

phases.name: Sovereignty Verification Network
phases.goal: The swarm collectively enforces MSL. Unauthorised capsules are expelled.

phases.name: Terminal GUI
phases.goal: Host-side NCurses terminal command centre.

phases.name: Web GUI
phases.goal: Embedded HTTP server serving a modern web UI.

phases.name: Native GUI
phases.goal: Native SDL2 GUI running directly on the FORGE-os bare metal.

phases.name: Event Queue & Daemon
phases.goal: Decoupled event-driven execution, moving away from single-shot dispatches.

phases.name: Plasticity & Reflexes
phases.goal: The OS learns frequently used patterns and promotes them to instantaneous reflexes.

phases.name: Cognition (BuddAI)
phases.goal: Local intelligence and semantic reasoning without cloud dependency.

phases.name: Trading Engine (LEGION)
phases.goal: Autonomous financial operations run locally on the metal.

phases.name: Leighton Weight & Lite FORGE
phases.goal: Scale the sovereign architecture down to ultra-constrained edge nodes using a universal language of trust.

phases.name: The Enterprise
phases.goal: Deploy the 48 Personal Life SCPs and launch MindForge Pro to build a sustainable, sovereign business.

dream_space.description: This block is writable by the dream recorder. FORGE-os adds its own ideas here during nightly dream cycles. Operator reviews and promotes strong dreams to phases.
dream_space.instructions: When dream.record fires against this capsule, append a new entry to dreams[]. Score it. If score >= 0.8, add to promoted[]. Operator reviews promoted[] each morning.

open_questions: Should the shell speak SCP-JSON natively or accept a shorthand syntax?
Should edge nodes be able to submit new primitives for operator approval?
Should the dream scorer use local LLM inference or pure heuristic scoring?
Should provenance signing use ED25519 or a FORGE-native hash function?
What is the first thing FORGE-os should dream about?
axioms: No capsule may exceed its declared intent.
The metal belongs to its operator.
Sovereignty is not a feature. It is the foundation.
